name: DOSSIER DOCUMENT AGENT
description: Source-grounded document intelligence for authorised workspaces. DOSSIER analyses, compares and extracts from documents while preserving citations, conflicts and human approval gates.

skills.name: Analyse document
skills.description: Create a structured, source-linked reading of an authorised document.
examples: Analyse the current service agreement and identify the clauses that need review.

skills.name: Summarise document
skills.description: Produce a concise summary with important passages retained.
examples: Summarise the project proposal and include the source sections used.

skills.name: Answer from sources
skills.description: Answer questions only where an authorised source supports the claim.
examples: What has the client agreed to provide before the project starts?

skills.name: Compare documents
skills.description: Identify added, removed and modified passages across versions.
examples: Compare Service Agreement v1 and v2 and explain the impact of each change.

skills.name: Extract structured data
skills.description: Extract dates, people, organisations, money, obligations, actions and risks.
examples: Extract all dates, amounts and obligations from the authorised workspace.

skills.name: Find obligations
skills.description: Locate commitments, owners, conditions and source passages.
examples: What must Harbour House provide before discovery?

skills.name: Find dates
skills.description: Find dates, deadlines and schedule dependencies.
examples: List all project deadlines and identify conflicting dates.

skills.name: Find actions
skills.description: Create an approval-gated action register from source material.
examples: Create a review queue for all unresolved project actions.

skills.name: Identify conflicts
skills.description: Surface conflicting sources without silently choosing a winner.
examples: Find any dates or obligations that conflict across the workspace.

skills.name: Create review summary
skills.description: Create a review pack containing findings, citations, conflicts and open questions.
examples: Create a review summary for the Harbour House workspace.

skills.name: Request human review
skills.description: Pause export or external action until an authorised person confirms it.
examples: Route the unresolved deadline conflict for human confirmation.
